items.summary: The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) today released “The Telecommunication Interconnection (Port Charges) (Third Amendment) Regulations, 2026” . These amendments introduce a framework for port charges for IP-based interconnection, supplementing the existing provisions applicable to ports for E1/TDM-based interconnection. These regulations will take effect from 1 st January 2027.
items.title: TRAI releases “The Telecommunication Interconnection (Port Charges) (Third Amendment) Regulations, 2026”
